title: uml4net-sage datapackage.json
$comment: Scope decision: this covers ONLY the three genuinely tabular resources (metamodel-index, standard-profile-index, spec-clause-index). Per-element/per-clause markdown files and the overall knowledge-base layout are NOT described here - skills read them directly at their well-known, stable paths (metamodel/index.json, standard-profile/index.json, spec/index.json), exactly as in mycelium-hypha. Frictionless Data Package's real value - letting external tooling validate/load a dataset via a standard tabular schema - only applies to these three files; nothing in this plugin actually loads a datapackage.json at runtime, so this file exists for external-tooling interoperability and documentation, not as a required read for any skill.
description: A standard OKF Frictionless Data Package (https://datapackage.org) profile, restricted to the fields uml4net-sage actually populates. Generated by Uml4Net.Sage.Knowledge.DataPackageGenerator into knowledge/<version>/datapackage.json.

sources.description: The OMG URLs the knowledge base was derived from - always documented as NOT redistributed here (see NOTICE).

resources.description: 0-3 entries: metamodel-index and standard-profile-index are always present; spec-clause-index is present only once spec/index.json exists (PDFs fetched and extracted).
